text: New Era Cap is privately owned by its original founding family, the Kochs of Buffalo, New York, and led by fourth-generation CEO Chris Koch. In August 2022 ACON Investments closed a roughly $700 million continuation round for New Era Cap under which the NFL, NBA and MLB all became minority investors.
short: New Era Cap is the Koch family's private company; the NFL, NBA and MLB took minority stakes in 2022.

source.name: The Park Wholesale: Who Owns New Era Cap? New Era Cap Owner
source.quote: As of June 2024, New Era is privately owned by the original founding family, the Kochs, and ACON Investments owns a significant minority stake.
source.note: The same paragraph: 'The MLB, NFL, and NBA also hold minority stakes in New Era. New Era Cap is currently led by Chris Koch, CEO, who is the fourth-generation of the founding family.'
